title: MQTT Client Subscribe
text: Read messages from subscribed MQTT topics, 2 outputs; {Client} selects MQTT client, {Topics to subscribe} sets the list of MQTT and {Block sample time} sets the sample time for read operation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Topic_ x
ports.summary: Current messages from subscribed topics vector

ports.name: IsNew
ports.summary: Flag indicating if read message is new 0 | 1 | vector of logicals

params.name: Block sample time
params.values: Sample time for read operation -1 (default) | nonnegative scalar
